name: Auction no 5fungo ni
original_name: オークションの5分後に
source:
The protagonist (player) was put up for auction at a speed that would surprise even doujinshi fans! I wonder if someone will save you~! ... just a five-minute game where you decide the partner. 

◆ Connection to the previous work? There’s not really any, but the world view is almost the same. I think it’s fine even if you haven’t played the previous work, but it might be more fun if you have.

[Translated from [url=https://novelgame.jp/games/show/4015]Novelgame[/url]]
